init.title: Re-authenticate
init.description: The stored session has no account user id, so MQTT telemetry is disabled and the integration falls back to the REST condition endpoint with stale data. Start the re-authentication flow for this account; the repair disappears once the new session provides the user id.

user.title: Deepal Alternative
user.description: Set up your Changan Deepal account. Choose International for the My Changan app (email or SMS code login); choose SDA (China) only for a mainland-China account with a pasted access token.

data_description.platform: International (Europe) supports email or SMS code login, telemetry and, with a control PIN, signed remote commands. SDA (China) uses a long-lived access token from the SDA API.

sda.title: SDA (China) access token
sda.description: Paste an access token issued by the SDA platform. The SDK login example (deepal_sdk/examples/login_example.py) prints one.

data_description.access_token: Long-lived token used for every request. It is stored in the config entry; remove and re-add the integration to replace it.
data_description.country: ISO country code for the account, for example CN. Optional; defaults to ES.
data_description.phone: Phone number associated with the account. Optional, for reference only.

intl_method.title: International login
intl_method.description: Choose how your My Changan account signs in. Both methods send a one-time verification code and store the session tokens in Home Assistant.

data_description.login_method: Email code signs in with an email address; phone/SMS code signs in with a national mobile number plus its dial code.

intl_email.title: Email login
intl_email.description: Select the sales country registered in My Changan and the account email. Home Assistant will request a verification code.

data_description.country: Sales country of the account, for example Spain. It is sent as selectcountry and salesCountry; it does not change the API gateway.
data_description.email: Email used in the My Changan app. It is encrypted before it is sent.
data_description.environment: Regional gateway set used for the login. Choose the region the account belongs to; ASEAN accounts fail against the European gateway.

intl_email_code.title: Email verification code
intl_email_code.description: Enter the verification code that was sent to the email address.

data_description.auth_code: Numeric code from the email. It expires quickly; request a new one if it is rejected.

intl_phone.title: SMS login
intl_phone.description: Select the sales country and the national mobile number (without the country prefix). Home Assistant will request a verification code by SMS. Changan is currently not delivering SMS codes; if the SMS does not arrive, request the code again or switch to the email method.

data_description.country: Sales country of the account. Its dial code is sent together with the mobile number.
data_description.phone: National mobile number without the dial code, for example 600000000 for Spain (+34).
data_description.environment: Regional gateway set used for the login. Choose the region the account belongs to; ASEAN accounts fail against the European gateway.

intl_sms_code.title: SMS verification code
intl_sms_code.description: Enter the verification code that was sent by SMS.

data_description.auth_code: Numeric code from the SMS. It expires quickly; request a new one if it is rejected.

intl_code_menu.title: Code sent
intl_code_menu.description: Home Assistant has requested the verification code for {destination}. It can take a couple of minutes; check the spam folder too. If it does not arrive, resend it or correct the destination.

sda_reauth.title: SDA reauthentication
sda_reauth.description: Paste a new access token for this account. Home Assistant verifies it before replacing the stored one.

data_description.access_token: New long-lived SDA access token. The old token is replaced only after it is verified.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Changan Deepal API.
error.too_many_codes: Too many verification codes requested. Wait and try again.
error.account_not_registered: This account is not registered for the selected country.
error.bad_code: The verification code is invalid or has expired.
error.no_vehicles: The account has no vehicles linked.
error.wrong_account: This account does not own the configured vehicle.

init.title: Deepal Alternative options
init.description: Tune polling and diagnostics. The control PIN enables signed remote commands; the diagnostic options change how the API sees the client and should only be touched while troubleshooting.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant polls the vehicle when no MQTT telemetry is available, in seconds (30-3600).
data_description.control_pin: Remote-control PIN from My Changan. Required to lock/unlock, move the windows or open the trunk.
data_description.enable_api_logging: Write every API request and response to the Home Assistant log, with tokens, keys, VIN, email, phone, PIN and serial number hidden. Enable only while troubleshooting.
data_description.wake: Wake a sleeping MQTT vehicle before refreshing or sending a PIN command. Enabled by default; disable it to protect the 12 V battery if you refresh very often.
data_description.environment: Regional gateway set used for the international API. Europe by default.

error.invalid_pin: The control PIN is not valid for this account.
error.pin_rate_limited: No PIN attempts are left; wait before trying again.
